mutations.name: an inlined file is read through git/blobs anyway
kills: fileBytes over the REST wire decodes a file the contents API inlined without a blob read

mutations.name: a decoded length unlike the reported size is returned
kills: fileBytes over the REST wire throws when the decoded bytes are shorter than the size GitHub reported

mutations.name: a directory listing is read as a file
kills: fileBytes over the REST wire throws for a directory rather than read it as a file

mutations.name: the fake round-trips stored bytes through UTF-8
kills: fileBytes over the fake returns a PNG's bytes exactly, including bytes that are not valid UTF-8

mutations.name: fileBytes passes the path to the wire unvalidated
kills: fileBytes over the fake refuses a path that escapes the repo before any wire call
